senses.en_definition: To succeed, achieve victory, make progress, or accomplish something.

messages.en: Have you submitted that form yet? You said the website kept freezing earlier.
Yep! I managed to submit it after three tries. Such a relief! I've even got the confirmation email already.
Great! Keep that email so you can refer back to it easily later.

senses.en_definition: To fight or strive to overcome opposition, defend a cause, or achieve a goal.
To clash or fight with one another, especially of large animals.

collocations.en: elephants fighting one another; powerful rivals clashing

messages.en: I'm so worn out from revising. I feel like nothing's sinking in anymore.
Take a quick break first. We've only got one exam left tomorrow. Let's keep going right to the end! Then let's go out for a really good meal.

senses.en_definition: To meet or go to see someone, usually for a particular purpose.

collocations.en: meet with the primary school headteacher

messages.en: It's been ages since we last met up. Are you free tomorrow? Let's grab a drink at our usual place.
Sure! I'd love to hear what you've been up to as well. Five o'clock as usual?

senses.en_definition: To get married; to enter into marriage.

collocations.en: marry someone of one's own choosing

senses.en_definition: To be married; to have a spouse.

messages.en: I'm planning to get married at the end of this year. You've got to come, okay!
Wow, congratulations! Have you set a date yet? I want to put in for leave early.
Not yet. We're still discussing it with the family. Once it's set, you'll be the first to know.
